description:
Look up six chemicals on the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), determine whether each can undergo hazardous polymerization, identify triggering conditions for those that can, and save the results as a structured CSV file. 

Chemicals to Assess:
1. Styrene
2. Acrylic Acid
3. Vinyl Acetate
4. Acetone
5. Methyl Methacrylate
6. Toluene

Create a CSV file at '~/Documents/polymerization_assessment.csv' with the following columns: 'Chemical Name', 'CAS Number', 'Polymerization Hazard' (YES/NO), and 'Triggering Conditions' (list conditions for YES, or N/A for NO).
